check_service_status.description: Check whether the Advice Slip API is answering, and how quickly. This is the one action that reports a problem as a value instead of failing the step, so a workflow can decide what to do about it. Being throttled is reported separately from being down.

mock_response.message: The Advice Slip API is up and answering.

check_service_status.name: check_service_status

message.description: One sentence saying how it went.

online.description: True when the service answered with advice.

rate_limited.description: True when the service said it is getting too many requests.

reachable.description: True when the service answered at all, even with an error.

response_time_ms.description: How long it took to answer, in milliseconds.

status_code.description: The HTTP status it answered with, or empty when it couldn't be reached.

get_advice_by_id.description: Get one specific piece of advice by its id, for re-posting something an earlier step found. Ids are whole numbers the service assigns once, so an id stored last month still means the same advice. A full Advice Slip URL is accepted in place of the bare id.

slip.advice: Don't be afraid to ask questions.

get_advice_by_id.name: get_advice_by_id

parameters.description: The slip's id, or the full Advice Slip link to it. Usually this comes from an earlier step: every action here returns the id of each slip it hands back, and ids are assigned once, so one stored last month still means the same advice.
parameters.name: slip_id

slip_id.description: The slip's id. Ids never change, so it can be stored and looked up again later.

url.description: A link to the slip on the Advice Slip API.

get_advice_of_the_day.description: Pick one piece of advice for a day and keep picking that same one all day. A random draw gives something different on every call, so a daily workflow that retries, or that two people run an hour apart, posts two different slips for the one day. This one is fixed by the date: the same date always gives the same advice. Each day's pick is made on its own, so now and then two days in a row share one. Add a seed of your own to have two workspaces post different advice on the same day. For the service's own published pick, which is the same for everyone and only ever covers today, use Get today's published advice instead.

slip.advice: Sleep on a big decision before you make it.

get_advice_of_the_day.name: get_advice_of_the_day

parameters.description: The day to pick advice for. Leave empty for today in UTC, which is what a scheduled step wants. Any date works, past or future.
parameters.name: date

parameters.description: Any text you like, mixed into the day so that two workspaces running this on the same day get different advice. Leave empty to share the day's advice with everyone else running it unseeded.
parameters.name: seed

date.description: The day the advice is for, as YYYY-MM-DD.

pool_size.description: How many pieces of advice it was picked from.

seed.description: What fixed the pick: the day, followed by your seed when you gave one.

slip_id.description: The slip's id. Ids never change, so it can be stored and looked up again later.

url.description: A link to the slip on the Advice Slip API.

get_advice_picture.description: Get a picture of one piece of advice printed on a paper receipt, to post as an image in a chat, an email or a page instead of as text. Gives back a link to the picture, checked to be there, and the advice itself to use as its caption or alt text.
get_advice_picture.display_str_template: Get a picture of advice slip {0}.

slip.advice: Don't be afraid to ask questions.

get_advice_picture.name: get_advice_picture

parameters.description: The slip's id, or the full Advice Slip link to it. Usually this comes from an earlier step: every action here returns the id of each slip it hands back, and ids are assigned once, so one stored last month still means the same advice.
parameters.name: slip_id

parameters.description: How big a picture. Each is the same receipt, drawn wider or narrower. Defaults to medium.
parameters.name: size

image_url.description: A link to the picture, a PNG that can be posted as an image.

size.description: The size of the picture: thumbnail, small, medium or large.

slip_id.description: The slip's id. Ids never change, so it can be stored and looked up again later.

url.description: A link to the slip on the Advice Slip API.

get_daily_advice_feed.description: Read the one piece of advice the service itself publishes each day, from its daily RSS feed. Everyone reading it that day gets the same advice, and it only ever covers today. To pick advice for a date of your own, or to give each workspace its own, use Get advice for a day instead.

slip.advice: Don't be afraid to ask questions.
slip.title: Don't be afraid to ask questions.

get_daily_advice_feed.name: get_daily_advice_feed

slip.description: Today's piece of advice, as the service's feed publishes it.

image_url.description: A picture of the slip printed on a paper receipt, 576 pixels wide, ready to post as an image.

published_at.description: When the feed published it, as the feed writes it, such as 'Fri, 06 Nov 2026 00:00:00 +0000'.

slip_id.description: The slip's id. Ids never change, so it can be stored and looked up again later.

title.description: The feed item's title, which is the advice again.

url.description: The feed's link to the slip, which opens it on the adviceslip.com website.

get_random_advice.description: Get one random piece of advice, ready to post, with a link back to it. The service caches its random pick for two seconds, so two steps run back to back get the same slip; hand back the id you posted last time to draw a different one instead.
get_random_advice.display_str_template: Get a random piece of advice.

slip.advice: Don't be afraid to ask questions.

get_random_advice.name: get_random_advice

parameters.description: The id of a slip you have already posted. The draw is repeated until it lands on something else, which costs about two and a half seconds per re-draw because of the service's own cache. Leave empty to take whatever comes. If every re-draw still lands on it, the slip is returned anyway with 'is_repeat' set rather than failing the step.
parameters.name: avoid_slip_id

avoided_slip_id.description: The id the step was told not to repeat, or empty when it was given none.

is_repeat.description: True when every re-draw still landed on the slip it was told not to repeat, so this is that slip again.

redraws.description: How many times the draw was repeated to get past the slip it was told not to repeat.

slip_id.description: The slip's id. Ids never change, so it can be stored and looked up again later.

url.description: A link to the slip on the Advice Slip API.

get_random_advice_about.description: Get one random piece of advice about a subject, such as work, money or friends: for a chat command that answers with advice on whatever someone asked about. Only advice where the subject starts a word counts, so 'friend' finds 'friends' but 'art' doesn't find 'start'. There is no two-second wait, unlike Get random advice. When no advice is about the subject the step still succeeds, with 'found' set to false and no slip, so the workflow can say so.
get_random_advice_about.display_name: Get random advice about a subject

slip.advice: Always drink a glass of water before your morning coffee.

get_random_advice_about.name: get_random_advice_about

parameters.description: A word or short phrase the advice should be about. Capital letters make no difference. It travels in the URL path, so it is limited to 100 characters.
parameters.name: subject

parameters.description: The id of a slip you have already posted. It is left out of the pick whenever any other advice is about the subject. If it is the only one, it is returned anyway with 'is_repeat' set rather than failing the step.
parameters.name: avoid_slip_id

parameters.description: Also count advice where the subject is inside a longer word, such as 'asleep' for 'sleep'. Off by default, because it also finds 'start' for 'art'.
parameters.name: match_inside_words

get_random_advice_about.result_str_template: Looked for advice about the subject.

avoided_slip_id.description: The id the step was told not to repeat, or empty when it was given none.

candidate_count.description: How many pieces of advice are about the subject, which is how many it was picked from.

found.description: True when some advice is about the subject. When false, there is no slip.

is_repeat.description: True when the slip it was told not to repeat is the only advice about the subject, so this is that slip again.

slip.description: The piece of advice picked, or empty when none is about the subject.

slip_id.description: The slip's id. Ids never change, so it can be stored and looked up again later.

url.description: A link to the slip on the Advice Slip API.

subject.description: The subject that was asked about.

get_random_advice_batch.description: Get several different pieces of advice at once, up to 10. No slip is drawn twice in the same batch. The service returns one random slip per request and caches it for two seconds, so a batch waits that out between draws and takes roughly two and a half seconds per slip after the first, which is exactly why the same loop built by hand returns the same slip over and over.

slips.advice: Always drink a glass of water before your morning coffee.
Don't be afraid to ask questions.
Sleep on a big decision before you make it.

get_random_advice_batch.name: get_random_advice_batch

parameters.description: How many pieces of advice to draw, from 1 to 10. Defaults to 3. Each one after the first adds about two and a half seconds to the step.
parameters.name: count

requested_count.description: How many pieces of advice were asked for.

slip_count.description: How many came back. Fewer than asked for means the service kept handing back ones already drawn.

slips.description: The pieces of advice, each one different.

slip_id.description: The slip's id. Ids never change, so it can be stored and looked up again later.

url.description: A link to the slip on the Advice Slip API.

search_advice.description: Find the advice that mentions something: a subject, a habit or a word, best match first. The service publishes no relevance of its own, so matches are ranked here with a whole-word hit worth far more than one buried inside a longer word. A search that matches nothing comes back as an empty result rather than failing the step.

matches.advice: Always drink a glass of water before your morning coffee.

search_advice.name: search_advice

parameters.description: The word or phrase to look for in the advice. It travels in the URL path, so it is limited to 100 characters.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: How many matches to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 10. The service's own total is always reported, however many are returned.
parameters.name: limit

match_count.description: How many matches are listed here.

matches.description: The matching advice, best match first.

slip_id.description: The slip's id. Ids never change, so it can be stored and looked up again later.

url.description: A link to the slip on the Advice Slip API.

returned_all.description: True when every match is listed, false when 'Number of results' left some out.

total_matches.description: How many slips the service says match in all.

description: Pull one-line advice from the Advice Slip API, the free keyless collection behind adviceslip.com. Draw a piece at random, several at once or one about a subject, search the collection, look one up by id, get it as a picture to post, read the advice the service publishes each day, or pick advice for a date that stays the same all day so a scheduled post never tells two. The service caches its random pick for two seconds, which is handled here rather than left to surprise a workflow.
